description: This file defines the LDAPSyncStatus class within the OrangeHRM project, representing the entity for tracking LDAP synchronization statuses. It includes properties for timestamps, status, associated user, and ORM mapping details.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatus
classes.description: Entity class representing LDAP synchronization status, with ORM annotations for database mapping and constants for sync states.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the sync status record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the sync status record.

methods.name: getSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when sync started.

methods.name: setSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when sync started.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when sync finished.

methods.name: setSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when sync finished.

methods.name: getSyncedBy
methods.description: Gets the User entity who performed the sync.

methods.name: setSyncedBy
methods.description: Sets the User entity who performed the sync.
